_schema.description: Workload is represented as a high-level execution DAG. Each entry in nodes is a DAG node. The generator expands collective nodes into low-level Chakra SEND/RECV nodes and preserves dependencies.

collective.description: A high-level collective communication node. The generator expands it into SEND/RECV DAG nodes.

compute.description: A computation node executed by the listed ranks. The cycles value is written directly to Chakra duration_micros, so one configured unit is one microsecond. In ASTRA-sim replay mode it is converted to 1000 nanosecond-scale simulator ticks (reported as cycles in runtime logs).

join.description: A zero-work synchronization node. It becomes ready only after all nodes listed in depends_on finish.

dependency_rules: depends_on contains names of predecessor DAG nodes.
A node becomes ready only after all nodes in depends_on complete.
An empty depends_on means the node is ready at workload start.
Collective dependencies are translated by the generator to dependencies on the terminal SEND/RECV nodes of the expanded collective.
The workload graph must be acyclic.
